summary: Teacher with roughly a decade of classroom experience spanning early childhood through elementary grades, including kindergarten and lead preschool roles that build math, literacy and social skills. Also has accounts receivable and customer service experience handling collections, client relations and daily and monthly collection goals. Plans lessons, tracks grades, reports and coaches PE in a teaching role spanning all subjects, with strengths in positive classroom management, modeling and parent communication. Holds a bachelor's degree in education and Texas teaching certification for EC through 4th grade.
